room_identity: The last room. A bone throne on the central mass, and a camp nobody left.

provenance.correction_to_the_brief: The brief's Z coordinates sit 12 units BELOW the committed FinalRoomLayout - it puts the benches at Z~68.5 when the room's south wall is Z 76, which would place them outside the room. Two independent cross-checks fix the offset at exactly +12: 68.5+12 = 80.5 is WestBenchBounds' centre to the decimal, and the round table's Z 75-77 +12 = 87-89 is 'roughly level with the obstacle' (FR1 spans Z 87..94) exactly as the brief says it should be. The brief also names the central mass FinalObstacleBounds; the committed layout calls it FR1Bounds. Layout wins, intent is honoured at the corrected coordinates.

builder_contract.pivot: Committed pivot and PPU from PropCatalog.json; the builder never recomputes one.
builder_contract.y_is_always_zero: Every placement sits on the floor at y=0, including the throne. The throne is centred on the mass's FOOTPRINT the way Lower Vault's landmark is centred on LV-C1 - it is not stood on top of the volume.
builder_contract.sorting: sorting_order = round((x - z) * 10); larger x-z is nearer the camera. The comedy cake sits just north-west of the table centre and must draw in front of it, which this ordering already gives.
builder_contract.colliders: The dressing prefab carries NO colliders.
builder_contract.lie_within_props: fr_ritual_bone_candle_ring and shared_bone_pile_b are lie_within - the most of any room. Both take the alpha-box centre, not a ground line. The ring has h=0.3 because its candles rise, and it still LIES; anchoring it on a ground line would shove it behind its layout point.

clearance_proved.camp_to_mass: The round table is asserted >= 2.0 clear of FR1 so it cannot merge with it.
clearance_proved.circulation: West and east lanes swept every 0.5 units of z beside the mass: >= 3.0 clear.
clearance_proved.chain_rows: Both chain-post rows are asserted to stop >= 1.0 short of the mass's corners, so neither the west nor the east lane can read as fenced off.
